text: 'athena land --pr' opened PR #39 for job 20261013-150709-b67z, but CI's 'athena check --history' failed on that branch with 2 violations: the pushed candidate commit dd50c2b changes governed content with no Athena-Job trailer, and the records commit de4ef6a changes records with no trailer naming its job. Every commit pushed to athena/<job> must pass 'athena check --history' on its own, as the commits on main do. One way to get that is to push the job's locally landed commit, which already carries the trailers and the records, instead of the bare candidate. Pick the approach and record why. Running 'athena land --pr' again on a job whose PR is already open must replace that branch's head with the fixed commit (athena/<job> is Athena's own branch) and reuse the open PR, so rerunning on job b67z repairs PR #39. Add tests.
